findings.passage: Gun violence in Washington state breaks apart too many families and kills too many children. We must put commonsense reforms into place that save lives.
findings.note: Statement quoted by a news outlet (OPB, reprinting Washington State Standard) at the signing of the permit-to-purchase bill.
Governor signed HB 1163, requiring a five-year State Patrol permit, with a fee and a firearms safety course, to buy a gun, starting May 1, 2027. Source is a news story; the bill page was not fetched.

Governor signed HB 2320, which regulates digital gun blueprints and bars using 3D printers and CNC mills to make guns or machine-gun conversion devices. Source is an advocacy group's release, not an official page.
